localizedDescriptions.nb: Svaret har blitt modifisert etter å ha vært i status "Endelig" og er komplett og verifisert. Dette er en underkategori til "Revidert".

localizedDescriptions.nl: *The result has been modified subsequent to being Final, and is complete and verified by the responsible pathologist. This is a sub-category of 'Amended'.(en)

localizedDescriptions.de: Nach der endgültigen Fassung wurde der Bericht durch Hinzufügen neuer Inhalte aktualisiert. Der bestehende Inhalt bleibt unverändert. Dies ist eine Unterkategorie von "Abgeändert".
localizedDescriptions.fi: *Subsequent to being final, the report has been modified by adding new content. The existing content is unchanged. This is a sub-category of 'Amended'.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Det slutgiltiga undersökningsresultatet har ändrats genom att nytt innehåll har inkluderats. Det befintliga innehållet är oförändrat. Detta är en underkategori av "Reviderad".
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: *Subsequent to being final, the report has been modified by adding new content. The existing content is unchanged. This is a sub-category of 'Amended'.(en)
localizedDescriptions.en: Subsequent to being final, the report has been modified by adding new content. The existing content is unchanged. This is a sub-category of 'Amended'.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *Subsequent to being final, the report has been modified by adding new content. The existing content is unchanged. This is a sub-category of 'Amended'.(en)
localizedDescriptions.it: Dopo essere stato dichiarato definitivo, il rapporto è stato modificato con l'aggiunta di nuovi contenuti. Il contenuto pre-esistente è rimasto invariato. Questa è una sottocategoria di "Modificato".
localizedDescriptions.fr: Après avoir été finalisé, le rapport a été modifié par l'ajout de nouveaux éléments. Le contenu existant reste inchangé. Il s'agit d'une sous-catégorie de « Modifié ».
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 在达到最终状态之后，因为添加新的内容而造成报告的修改。已有的内容并未发生变更。这是“经过修正”类别的一个子类别。
localizedDescriptions.es: Tras ser definitivo, el informe se ha modificado añadiendo nuevos contenidos. El contenido existente no se ha modificado. Se trata de una subcategoría de "Modificado".
localizedDescriptions.nb: Etter å ha vært satt som status "Endelig", har det blitt lagt nytt innhold til rapporten. Det eksisterende innholdet er uendret. Dette er en underkategori av "Revidert".
localizedDescriptions.ca: Després de ser definitiu, l'informe s'ha modificat afegint-hi continguts nous. No s'ha modificat el contingut existent. Es tracta d'una subcategoria de "modificat".
localizedDescriptions.nl: *Subsequent to being final, the report has been modified by adding new content. The existing content is unchanged. This is a sub-category of 'Amended'.(en)

localizedDescriptions.de: Dies gibt an, ob der Test direkt am Point-of-Care (POCT) durchgeführt wurde, im Gegensatz zu einem formalen Ergebnis eines Labors oder einer anderen Dienstleistungsorganisation.
localizedDescriptions.fi: *This indicates whether the test was performed directly at Point-of-Care (POCT) as opposed to a formal result from a laboratory or other service delivery organisation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Indikerar om analysen utfördes som en patientnära analys (PNA), det vill säga på vårdenhet, istället för en mer formell laboratorietjänst.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: *This indicates whether the test was performed directly at Point-of-Care (POCT) as opposed to a formal result from a laboratory or other service delivery organisation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.en: This indicates whether the test was performed directly at Point-of-Care (POCT) as opposed to a formal result from a laboratory or other service delivery organisation.

localizedDescriptions.it: Questo elemento indica se il test è stato eseguito direttamente presso il punto di assistenza (Point-of-Care, POCT), rispetto a un risultato formale di un laboratorio o di un'altra organizzazione che fornisce servizi.
localizedDescriptions.fr: Cela permet d’indiquer si l'analyse a été réalisé directement au point de soins (POCT), par opposition à un résultat officiel provenant d’un laboratoire ou d’un autre prestataire de services.
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 此项数据元旨在表明当前的检验项目究竟是床旁（Point-of-Care，POCT）直接进行的检验项目，而不是实验室或其他服务机构/部门/科室所提供的正式结果。
localizedDescriptions.es: Indica si la prueba se realizó directamente en el punto de atención (POCT), en contraposición a un resultado formal de un laboratorio u otra organización de prestación de servicios.
localizedDescriptions.nb: Dette indikerer hvorvidt analysen ble utført gjennom pasientnær analysering (PNA) i stedet for en mer formell laboratorietjeneste.
localizedDescriptions.ca: Indica si la prova es va fer directament al punt d'atenció (POCT), en contraposició a un resultat formal d'un laboratori o una altra organització de prestació de serveis.

localizedNames.es: Prueba en el punto de atención sanitaria

localizedDescriptions.de: Dies gibt an, ob der Test direkt am Point-of-Care (POCT) durchgeführt wurde, im Gegensatz zu einem formalen Ergebnis eines Labors oder einer anderen Dienstleistungsorganisation.
localizedDescriptions.fi: *This indicates whether the test was performed directly at Point-of-Care (POCT) as opposed to a formal result from a laboratory or other service delivery organisation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Indikerar om analysen utfördes som en patientnära analys (PNA), det vill säga på vårdenhet, istället för en mer formell laboratorietjänst.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: *This indicates whether the test was performed directly at Point-of-Care (POCT) as opposed to a formal result from a laboratory or other service delivery organisation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.en: This indicates whether the test was performed directly at Point-of-Care (POCT) as opposed to a formal result from a laboratory or other service delivery organisation.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *This indicates whether the test was performed directly at Point-of-Care (POCT) as opposed to a formal result from a laboratory or other service delivery organisation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.it: Questo elemento indica se il test è stato eseguito direttamente presso il punto di assistenza (Point-of-Care, POCT), rispetto a un risultato formale di un laboratorio o di un'altra organizzazione che fornisce servizi.
localizedDescriptions.fr: Cela permet d’indiquer si l'analyse a été réalisé directement au point de soins (POCT), par opposition à un résultat officiel provenant d’un laboratoire ou d’un autre prestataire de services.
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 此项数据元旨在表明当前的检验项目究竟是床旁（Point-of-Care，POCT）直接进行的检验项目，而不是实验室或其他服务机构/部门/科室所提供的正式结果。
localizedDescriptions.es: Indica si la prueba se realizó directamente en el punto de atención (POCT), en contraposición a un resultado formal de un laboratorio u otra organización de prestación de servicios.
localizedDescriptions.nb: Dette indikerer hvorvidt analysen ble utført gjennom pasientnær analysering (PNA) i stedet for en mer formell laboratorietjeneste.
localizedDescriptions.ca: Indica si la prova es va fer directament al punt d'atenció (POCT), en contraposició a un resultat formal d'un laboratori o una altra organització de prestació de serveis.
localizedDescriptions.nl: *This indicates whether the test was performed directly at Point-of-Care (POCT) as opposed to a formal result from a laboratory or other service delivery organisation.(en)

localizedDescriptions.de: Beschreibung aller Probleme oder Faktoren, die sich auf die Messung des Körpergewichts auswirken können, z. B. das Timing im Menstruationszyklus, das Timing des letzten Stuhlgangs oder das Feststellen einer Amputation.
localizedDescriptions.fi: Kirjaa tekijät, jotka voivat vaikuttaa painon mittaustulokseen. Esimerkiksi kuukautiskierron vaihe, suolen toiminnan edellinen ajankohta tai amputaation huomioiminen.
localizedDescriptions.ru: *Record any issues or factors that may impact on the measurement of body weight eg timing in menstrual cycle, timing of recent bowel motion or noting of amputation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Beskrivning av faktorer och felkällor som kan påverka mätningen av kroppsvikt, exempelvis tidpunkt i menstruationscykeln, tid sedan senaste tarmtömning eller amputation.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: Registra qualquer problemas ou fatores que impactam na medida do peso corporal pe período menstrual, período recente de movimento peristáltico e observação de amputação.
localizedDescriptions.en: Record any issues or factors that may impact on the measurement of body weight eg timing in menstrual cycle, timing of recent bowel motion or noting of amputation.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *Record any issues or factors that may impact on the measurement of body weight eg timing in menstrual cycle, timing of recent bowel motion or noting of amputation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.fr: Enregistrez toutes les questions ou facteurs qui peuvent avoir un impact sur la mesure du poids corporel, par exemple le moment du cycle menstruel, le moment de la défécation récente ou la constatation d'une amputation.
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 用于记录任何可能对体重测量造成影响的问题或因素，如月经周期所处时间阶段、最近排便的时间安排情况或者截肢情况说明。
localizedDescriptions.es: *Record any issues or factors that may impact on the measurement of body weight eg timing in menstrual cycle, timing of recent bowel motion or noting of amputation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.nb: Registering av emner eller faktorer som kan ha betydning for måling av kroppsvekten, f.eks. inntak av mat og drikke, stort saltinntak, menstruasjonssyklus, tidspunkt for avføring, ødem eller uke av graviditet.
localizedDescriptions.ja: 体重計測に影響を与えうるすべての要素や問題。例えば、月経周期や直近の排便時、四肢切断の有無。
localizedDescriptions.fa: *Record any issues or factors that may impact on the measurement of body weight eg timing in menstrual cycle, timing of recent bowel motion or noting of amputation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.ca: Registrar qualsevol problema o factor que pugui afectar la mesura del pes corporal; per exemple, en el cicle menstrual, moviment intestinal recent o registre d'una amputació.
localizedDescriptions.nl: Leg elke gegeven of factor vast die invloed heeft op de meting van het lichaamsgewicht, bijvoorbeeld moment in de menstruele cyclus, tijd sinds recente ontlasting of een amputatie.

localizedDescriptions.de: Beschreibung aller Probleme oder Faktoren, die sich auf die Messung des Körpergewichts auswirken können, z. B. das Timing im Menstruationszyklus, das Timing des letzten Stuhlgangs oder das Feststellen einer Amputation.
localizedDescriptions.fi: Kirjaa tekijät, jotka voivat vaikuttaa painon mittaustulokseen. Esimerkiksi kuukautiskierron vaihe, suolen toiminnan edellinen ajankohta tai amputaation huomioiminen.
localizedDescriptions.ru: *Record any issues or factors that may impact on the measurement of body weight eg timing in menstrual cycle, timing of recent bowel motion or noting of amputation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Beskrivning av faktorer och felkällor som kan påverka mätningen av kroppsvikt, exempelvis tidpunkt i menstruationscykeln, tid sedan senaste tarmtömning eller amputation.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: Registra qualquer problemas ou fatores que impactam na medida do peso corporal pe período menstrual, período recente de movimento peristáltico e observação de amputação.
localizedDescriptions.en: Record any issues or factors that may impact on the measurement of body weight eg timing in menstrual cycle, timing of recent bowel motion or noting of amputation.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *Record any issues or factors that may impact on the measurement of body weight eg timing in menstrual cycle, timing of recent bowel motion or noting of amputation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.fr: Enregistrez toutes les questions ou facteurs qui peuvent avoir un impact sur la mesure du poids corporel, par exemple le moment du cycle menstruel, le moment de la défécation récente ou la constatation d'une amputation.
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 用于记录任何可能对体重测量造成影响的问题或因素，如月经周期所处时间阶段、最近排便的时间安排情况或者截肢情况说明。
localizedDescriptions.es: *Record any issues or factors that may impact on the measurement of body weight eg timing in menstrual cycle, timing of recent bowel motion or noting of amputation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.nb: Registering av emner eller faktorer som kan ha betydning for måling av kroppsvekten, f.eks. inntak av mat og drikke, stort saltinntak, menstruasjonssyklus, tidspunkt for avføring, ødem eller uke av graviditet.
localizedDescriptions.ja: 体重計測に影響を与えうるすべての要素や問題。例えば、月経周期や直近の排便時、四肢切断の有無。
localizedDescriptions.fa: *Record any issues or factors that may impact on the measurement of body weight eg timing in menstrual cycle, timing of recent bowel motion or noting of amputation.(en)
localizedDescriptions.ca: Registrar qualsevol problema o factor que pugui afectar la mesura del pes corporal; per exemple, en el cicle menstrual, moviment intestinal recent o registre d'una amputació.
localizedDescriptions.nl: Leg elke gegeven of factor vast die invloed heeft op de meting van het lichaamsgewicht, bijvoorbeeld moment in de menstruele cyclus, tijd sinds recente ontlasting of een amputatie.

localizedDescriptions.de: Der Rezeptentwurf wurde erstellt und wartet auf die Bestätigung durch einen autorisierten Arzt. Kann auch verwendet werden, wenn die Re-autorisierung gebündelt erfolgt. Dieser "careflow_step" hat den Status "geplant" oder "aktiv", was die Notwendigkeit widerspiegelt, sowohl Neuaufträge als auch erneut autorisierte Aufträge zu bearbeiten.
localizedDescriptions.ru: *Draft prescription has been prepared and is awaiting confirmation from an authorised clinician. May be used where reauthorisations are performed as a batch. This careflow_step may have a status of 'planned' or 'active', reflecting the need to to handle new orders as well as re-authorised orders.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Förslag på ordination har utarbetats och inväntar bekräftelse från en auktoriserad läkare. Kan användas där återauktorisering utförs som en batch. Detta flödessteg kan ha statusen "planerad" eller "aktiv", vilket återspeglar behovet av att hantera nya beställningar såväl som återauktoriserade ordrar.
localizedDescriptions.es-ar: *Draft prescription has been prepared and is awaiting confirmation from an authorised clinician. May be used where reauthorisations are performed as a batch. This careflow_step may have a status of 'planned' or 'active', reflecting the need to to handle new orders as well as re-authorised orders.(en)
localizedDescriptions.nb: Det er forberedt et utkast for en resept, og denne avventer godkjenning av en autorisert kliniker. Kan brukes der reseptutstedelse utføres satsvis. Dette prosesstrinnet kan brukes enten med status "planned" eller "active", for å underbygge behovet for å håndtere både nye og reautoriserte ordinasjoner.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: Rascunho da prescrição foi preparado e está aguardando confirmação de um clínico autorizado. Pode ser usado quando reautorizações são realizadas em lote. Esta etapa do processo de cuidado pode ter um estado de "planejado" ou "ativo", refletindo a necessidade de gerir novas solicitações assim como solicitações reautorizadas.
localizedDescriptions.en: Draft prescription has been prepared and is awaiting confirmation from an authorised clinician. May be used where reauthorisations are performed as a batch. This careflow_step may have a status of 'planned' or 'active', reflecting the need to to handle new orders as well as re-authorised orders.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *Draft prescription has been prepared and is awaiting confirmation from an authorised clinician. May be used where reauthorisations are performed as a batch. This careflow_step may have a status of 'planned' or 'active', reflecting the need to to handle new orders as well as re-authorised orders.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sl: *Draft prescription has been prepared and is awaiting confirmation from an authorised clinician. May be used where reauthorisations are performed as a batch. This careflow_step may have a status of 'planned' or 'active', reflecting the need to to handle new orders as well as re-authorised orders.(en)
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 已经准备/书写好了处方草稿，正在等待授权临床医务人员的确认。可以用于批量执行重新授权的情况。照护服务流程步骤（careflow_step）的状态可能是“已计划”或“有效”，反映的则是需要处理新的医嘱以及重新授权的医嘱。
localizedDescriptions.ca: S’ha preparat un esborrany de la prescripció i està pendent de confirmació per part d’un metge autoritzat. Es pot utilitzar quan les reautoritzacions es fan per lots. Aquest careflow_step pot tenir un estat «planificat» o «actiu», cosa que reflecteix la necessitat de gestionar tant prescripcions noves com prescripcions reautoritzades.
localizedDescriptions.es: Se ha preparado una receta provisional y está pendiente de confirmación por parte de un clínico autorizado. Puede ser utilizada cuando se realicen reautorizaciones de forma conjunta. Este careflow_step puede tener un estado de "planificado" o "activo", reflejando la necesidad de manejar tanto órdenes nuevas como órdenes reautorizadas.

localizedDescriptions.nb: En repeterende resept har blitt reautorisert. I noen myndighetsområder må det i disse tilfellene utstedes en helt ny resept.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: A solicitação original da medicação foi reautorização para permitir prescrição ou dispensação repetida. Em algumas jurisdições uma nova solicitação deve ser emitida nestas circunstâncias.
localizedDescriptions.en: The original medication order has been re-authorised to allow repeat prescription or dispensing. In some jurisdictions an entirely new order must be issued in these circumstances.

localizedDescriptions.sl: *The original medication order has been re-authorised to allow repeat prescription or dispensing. In some jurisdictions an entirely new order must be issued in these circumstances.(en)
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 已经对原始的药物医嘱进行了重新授权，以便能够重复利用处方或配发药物。在某些司法管辖区域，在此类的情况下，必须签发/开出全新的医嘱。
localizedDescriptions.ca: S’ha reautoritzat la prescripció original per a permetre que es repeteixin tant la prescripció com la dispensació. En algunes jurisdiccions, s’ha d’emetre una prescripció nova en aquestes circumstàncies.
localizedDescriptions.es: La orden de medicación original ha sido reautorizada para permitir la repetición de la prescripción o dispensación. En algunas jurisdicciones, en estas circunstancias debe emitirse una orden completamente nueva.

localizedDescriptions.de: Das Arzneimittel wurde zum ersten Mal von dem Patienten eingenommen oder ihm verabreicht. Obwohl in einigen Situationen das relevante Datum als erste von mehreren Anwendungen errechenbar ist, kann es in der Grundversorgung sein, dass genaue Verabreichungszeit nicht ohne weiteres verfügbar ist.
localizedDescriptions.ru: *The medication has been taken by, or administered to, the patient for the first time. Although in some settings this significant date may be computable as the first of several administrations, in other settings, such as primary care, specific administration dates are not readily available.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Läkemedlet har tagits av eller administrerats till patienten för första gången. I vissa fall kan startdatum för varje administrationstillfälle finnas tillgängligt, medan det i andra fall (såsom i primärvården) inte gör det.
localizedDescriptions.es-ar: *The medication has been taken by, or administered to, the patient for the first time. Although in some settings this significant date may be computable as the first of several administrations, in other settings, such as primary care, specific administration dates are not readily available.(en)
localizedDescriptions.nb: Legemiddelet er inntatt av eller administrert til pasienten for første gang. Selv om dette i noen bruksområder som f.eks. sykehus kan utledes fra den første av en rekke administreringer, må det i andre bruksområder som f.eks. allmennpraksis spesifiseres spesifikt siden administreringer ikke dokumenteres på samme måte.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: A medicação foi adquirida, ou administrada, ao paciente pela primeira vez. Embora em algumas situações esta data significativa pode ser computada como a primeira de muitas administrações, em outras, como na atenção primária, datas de administração específicas não estão prontamente disponíveis.
localizedDescriptions.en: The medication has been taken by, or administered to, the patient for the first time. Although in some settings this significant date may be computable as the first of several administrations, in other settings, such as primary care, specific administration dates are not readily available.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *The medication has been taken by, or administered to, the patient for the first time. Although in some settings this significant date may be computable as the first of several administrations, in other settings, such as primary care, specific administration dates are not readily available.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sl: *The medication has been taken by, or administered to, the patient for the first time. Although in some settings this significant date may be computable as the first of several administrations, in other settings, such as primary care, specific administration dates are not readily available.(en)
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 患者已经首次服用相应的药物，或者说已经对其进行了首次的施用/给药。 尽管在某些场所环境下，这一重要的日期可以作为多次施用/给药之中的第一次而用于计算，而在其他的场所环境下，如初级照护服务（基层医疗服务），具体的施用/给药日期并不容易获得。
localizedDescriptions.ca: El pacient ha pres o se li ha administrat la medicació per primera vegada. Encara que en alguns entorns es pugui computar aquesta data significativa com la primera de diverses administracions, en altres entorns, com atenció primària, les dates d’administració específiques no són fàcilment accessibles.
localizedDescriptions.es: El paciente ha tomado o se le ha administrado el medicamento por primera vez. Aunque en algunos entornos esta fecha significativa puede ser calculada como la primera de varias administraciones, en otros contextos, como la atención primaria, las fechas específicas de administración no están fácilmente disponibles.

localizedDescriptions.de: Die Arzneimittelverordnung wurde so geändert, dass keine neue Verordnung/neues Rezept nach den lokalen klinischen Regeln ausgestellt werden muss.
localizedDescriptions.ru: *The medication order has been changed in a manner which does not require a new instruction/order to be issued, according to local clinical rules.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Läkemedelsordern har ändrats på ett sätt som inte kräver att en ny order ska utfärdas, enligt lokala kliniska regler.
localizedDescriptions.es-ar: *The medication order has been changed in a manner which does not require a new instruction/order to be issued, according to local clinical rules.(en)
localizedDescriptions.nb: Legemiddelordineringen er endret på en slik måte at det etter lokale retningslinjer ikke er behov for en ny ordinering. For eksempel endring av produkt fra tabletter til kapsler.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: A prescrição foi alterada de uma forma que não exige uma nova liberação da prescrição, de acordo com as regras clínicas locais.
localizedDescriptions.en: The medication order has been changed in a manner which does not require a new instruction/order to be issued, according to local clinical rules.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *The medication order has been changed in a manner which does not require a new instruction/order to be issued, according to local clinical rules.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sl: *The medication order has been changed in a manner which does not require a new instruction/order to be issued, according to local clinical rules.(en)
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 根据本地的临床规则，采取并不需要签发新的指令/医嘱的方式，对药物医嘱进行了变更。
localizedDescriptions.ca: La prescripció s’ha modificat de manera que no requereixi l’emissió d’una nova prescripció/instrucció, d’acord amb les normes clíniques locals.
localizedDescriptions.es: La orden de medicación se ha modificado de manera que no requiere emitir una nueva instrucción/orden, de acuerdo con las normas clínicas locales.

localizedDescriptions.de: Das individuelle Arzneimittel wurde neu bewertet, beispielsweise ob das Arzneimittel noch angewendet werden soll. Eine Überprüfung der Arzneimittelliste soll nicht durchgeführt werden.
localizedDescriptions.ru: *The specific medication item has been reviewed, as planned. This is not intended to capture review of the whole medication list.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Omprövning av det enskilda läkemedlet, exempelvis huruvida medicineringen ska fortskrida. Syftet är inte att skapa en översyn av läkemedelslistan.
localizedDescriptions.es-ar: *The specific medication item has been reviewed, as planned. This is not intended to capture review of the whole medication list.(en)
localizedDescriptions.nb: Legemiddelet er revurdert, for eksempel for hvorvidt det fortsatt skal tas. Dette er ikke ment å omfatte gjennomgang av en legemiddelliste.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: O item de medicação específico foi revisado, conforme planejado. Este não pretende capturar uma revisão da lista completa de medicação.
localizedDescriptions.en: The individual medication has been reassessed, for example whether the medication should still be taken. This is not intended to capture review of the medication list.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *The specific medication item has been reviewed, as planned. This is not intended to capture review of the whole medication list.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sl: *The specific medication item has been reviewed, as planned. This is not intended to capture review of the whole medication list.(en)
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 已经重新评估了相应的具体药物，如是否仍然应当服用该药物。 这一节点并非旨在用于采集药物清单的审核情况。
localizedDescriptions.ca: S’ha reavaluat la medicació concreta; per exemple, si s’ha de continuar prenent. Això no pretén recollir una revisió de la llista de medicació.
localizedDescriptions.es: Se ha reevaluado la medicación individual, por ejemplo, si debe seguir tomándose. No se trata de revisar la lista de medicamentos.

localizedDescriptions.de: Eine einzelne Verabreichung des Arzneimittels ist erfolgt.
localizedDescriptions.ru: *A single administration of the medication has taken place.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Engångsadministrering av läkemedlet.
localizedDescriptions.es-ar: *A single administration of the medication has taken place.(en)
localizedDescriptions.nb: En enkelt administrering av legemiddelet er utført.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: Dose do medicamento foi administrada.
localizedDescriptions.en: A single administration of the medication has taken place.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *A single administration of the medication has taken place.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sl: *A single administration of the medication has taken place.(en)
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 已经进行了单独一次的药物施用/给药。
localizedDescriptions.ca: S’ha realitzat una única administració de la medicació.
localizedDescriptions.es: Se ha realizado una única administración del medicamento.

localizedDescriptions.de: Eine Gabe des Arzneimittels wurde zurückgehalten und nicht gegeben. Es besteht keine Erwartung, dass sie später verabreicht wird, obwohl die nächste Dosis (falls es eine gibt) gemäß der ursprünglichen Verordnung verabreicht werden sollte.
localizedDescriptions.ru: *The administration of a medication has been withheld and not given. There is no expectation that it will be given later, though the next dose (if any) should be administered according to the original order.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Nekad administrering av läkemedlet. Denna dos förväntas inte att ges vid senare tillfälle, även om en eventuellt nästa dos ska administreras enligt planerat.
localizedDescriptions.es-ar: *The administration of a medication has been withheld and not given. There is no expectation that it will be given later, though the next dose (if any) should be administered according to the original order.(en)
localizedDescriptions.nb: En enkeltdose er holdt tilbake og ikke administrert ("nullet"). Det er ingen forventing om at den aktuelle dosen skal gis på et senere tidspunkt, men neste dose administreres i henhold til ordineringen.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: A administração de um medicamento foi suspensa e não realizada. Não há expectativa de que será dada mais tarde, embora a próxima dose (se houver) deva ser administrada conforme a prescrição original.
localizedDescriptions.en: An administration of the medication has been withheld and not given. There is no expectation that it will be given later, though the next dose (if any) should be administered according to the original order.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *The administration of a medication has been withheld and not given. There is no expectation that it will be given later, though the next dose (if any) should be administered according to the original order.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sl: *The administration of a medication has been withheld and not given. There is no expectation that it will be given later, though the next dose (if any) should be administered according to the original order.(en)
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 已经予以省略/扣除而并未给予的施用/给药。 虽说应该按照原始的医嘱来施用/给予下次剂量的药物（如果有的话），但并不期望后续会再施用/给予所省略/扣除的剂量。
localizedDescriptions.ca: S’ha retingut i no s’ha administrat un torn d’administració de la medicació. No s’espera que s’administri més tard, encara que la dosi següent (si n’hi hagués) s’ha d’administrar d’acord amb l’ordre original.
localizedDescriptions.es: Se ha retenido y no administrado una dosis del medicamento. No se espera que se administre más tarde, aunque la siguiente dosis (si la hubiera) debe administrarse de acuerdo con la orden original.

localizedDescriptions.de: Die Verabreichung einer Dosis hat sich verzögert, wird aber so schnell wie möglich erfolgen.
localizedDescriptions.ru: *Administration of a dose of mediciation has been delayed but is expected to be given as soon as possible.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: En dos av läkemedlet har försenats men förväntas administreras så snart som möjligt.
localizedDescriptions.es-ar: *Administration of a dose of mediciation has been delayed but is expected to be given as soon as possible.(en)
localizedDescriptions.nb: Administrering av legemiddelet er utsatt/forsinket, men legemiddelet forventes administrert så raskt som mulig.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: A administração de uma dose de medicamento foi adiada, mas espera-se que seja administrada o mais rápido possível.
localizedDescriptions.en: An administration of a dose of the medication has been delayed but is expected to be given as soon as possible.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *Administration of a dose of mediciation has been delayed but is expected to be given as soon as possible.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sl: *Administration of a dose of mediciation has been delayed but is expected to be given as soon as possible.(en)
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 已经推迟一剂药物的施用/给药，但预计会尽快施用/给药。
localizedDescriptions.ca: S’ha ajornat l’administració d’una dosi de la medicació, però s’espera que s’administri com més aviat millor.
localizedDescriptions.es: Se ha retrasado la administración de una dosis del medicamento, pero se espera que se administre lo antes posible.

localizedDescriptions.de: Das Rezept wurde aufgrund einer technischen oder pharmazeutischen Störung nicht ausgegeben.
localizedDescriptions.ru: *The prescription has not been dispensed due to a technical or pharamaceutical supply issue.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Ordinationen har inte delats ut på grund av ett teknisk eller faramaceutiskt leveransproblem.
localizedDescriptions.es-ar: *The prescription has not been dispensed due to a technical or pharamaceutical supply issue.(en)
localizedDescriptions.nb: Legemiddelet er ikke utdelt fordi det ikke er på lager enda.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: A prescrição não foi aviada devido a um problema técnico ou de suprimento farmacêutico.
localizedDescriptions.en: The prescription has not been dispensed due to a technical or pharamaceutical supply issue.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *The prescription has not been dispensed due to a technical or pharamaceutical supply issue.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sl: *The prescription has not been dispensed due to a technical or pharamaceutical supply issue.(en)
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 由于技术或药品供应问题，目前尚未配发相应的处方[药物]。
localizedDescriptions.ca: No s’ha dispensat la prescripció a causa d'un problema d’abastiment tècnic o farmacèutic.
localizedDescriptions.es: La receta no se ha dispensado debido a un problema técnico o de suministro farmacéutico.

localizedDescriptions.de: Die Verabreichung des Arzneimittels wurde bis zum Erhalt weiterer Informationen ausgesetzt. Es sollten keine weiteren Dosen, bis zur Bekanntgabe des neuen Startdatums oder bis die Bedingungen erfüllt sind, verabreicht werden. Wenn Sie das Datum/ die Voraussetzungen für den Neustart nach dem Aussetzen festlegen, sollte ein Schritt von "Verabreichung wurde ausgesetzt" und zurück zu "Arzneimittel Startdatum/Voraussetzung" ausgeführt werden.
localizedDescriptions.ru: *The administration of the medication has been suspended until further notice. No further doses should be given until the restart date or conditions have been met. When setting the date/conditions for restart after suspending, a step from ‘Administrations suspended’ and back to 'Medication start date/condition set' should be performed.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Administreringen av läkemedlet har avbrutits tills vidare. Inga ytterligare doser ska ges förrän ett nytt startdatum har angivits eller villkoren har uppfyllts. Vid inställning av in datum/villkor för omstart, ska stegen från "Läkemedlets startdatum/fastställda villkor" till "Indragen administrering" utföras på nytt.
localizedDescriptions.es-ar: *The administration of the medication has been suspended until further notice. No further doses should be given until the restart date or conditions have been met. When setting the date/conditions for restart after suspending, a step from ‘Administrations suspended’ and back to 'Medication start date/condition set' should be performed.(en)
localizedDescriptions.nb: Administrering av legemiddelet er satt på vent inntil videre, ordinasjonen er "nullet". Ingen ytterligere doser gis før kriterium eller dato for å sette medisineringen i gang igjen er møtt. Når dato eller kriterium for å ny oppstart settes, bør det gjøres et 'suspend_step' tilbake til "Oppstartsdato satt".
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: A administração do medicamento foi suspensa até nova ordem. Doses adicionais não devem ser administradas até que a data de reinício ou condições forem alcançadas. Na configuração de nova data/condições para reinício após a suspensão, deve-se realizar a etapa de suspensão de Administrações suspensas e voltar a Data do início/ Condição de início.
localizedDescriptions.en: The administration of the medication has been suspended until further notice. No further doses should be given until the restart date or conditions have been met. When setting the date/conditions for restart after suspending, a step from ‘Administrations suspended’ and back to 'Medication start date/condition set' should be performed.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *The administration of the medication has been suspended until further notice. No further doses should be given until the restart date or conditions have been met. When setting the date/conditions for restart after suspending, a step from ‘Administrations suspended’ and back to 'Medication start date/condition set' should be performed.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sl: *The administration of the medication has been suspended until further notice. No further doses should be given until the restart date or conditions have been met. When setting the date/conditions for restart after suspending, a step from ‘Administrations suspended’ and back to 'Medication start date/condition set' should be performed.(en)
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 已经暂停了相应药物的施用/给药，直至另行通知。 在重新开始日期之前或满足种种条件之前，不应再进行给予更多的剂量药物。 在设置暂停之后的重新开始日期/条件时，应当执行从“已暂停的施用/给药”（Administrations suspended）返回到“已设定的用药开始日期/条件”（Medication start date/condition set）的步骤。
localizedDescriptions.ca: S’ha suspès l’administració de la medicació fins a nou avís. No s’han d’administrar més dosis fins que no es compleixin la data o les condicions de reinici. Quan s’estableixin les condicions/data de reinici després de la suspensió, cal realitzar una fase des d'«Administració suspesa» i tornar a «Data d’inici de la medicació/condicions establertes».
localizedDescriptions.es: La administración del medicamento ha sido suspendida hasta nuevo aviso. No deben administrarse más dosis hasta que se haya restablecido la fecha de reinicio o se hayan cumplido las condiciones necesarias. Al establecer la fecha/condiciones de reinicio tras la suspensión, debe realizarse un paso desde 'Administración suspendida' y volver a 'Fecha de inicio de la medicación/condición establecida'.

localizedLabels.nb: Reautorisering av resept satt på vent
localizedLabels.zh-cn: 待处理的处方重新授权

localizedDescriptions.de: Die Ausstellung des Rezeptes wartet auf die erneute Autorisierung durch einen Arzt.
localizedDescriptions.ru: *Reissuing of this prescription is not available without some intervention.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Inväntar återauktorisering för ordination av en läkare.
localizedDescriptions.es-ar: *Reissuing of this prescription is not available without some intervention.(en)
localizedDescriptions.nb: Utstedelse av resept avventer reautorisering av en kliniker. I noen myndighetsområder kan ikke resepter reautoriseres, og det må i disse tilfellene utstedes en helt ny resept.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: Reemissão da prescrição não está disponível sem alguma intervenção.
localizedDescriptions.en: Issue of the prescription is awaiting re-authorisation by a clinician.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *Reissuing of this prescription is not available without some intervention.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sl: *Reissuing of this prescription is not available without some intervention.(en)
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 处方的签发正在等待临床医务人员的重新授权。
localizedDescriptions.ca: L'expedició de la prescripció està pendent d'una reautorització per part d'un metge.
localizedDescriptions.es: La emisión de la receta médica está pendiente de reautorización por parte de un clínico.

localizedLabels.zh-cn: 已停止的药物治疗过程

localizedDescriptions.de: Die Verabreichung des Arzneimittels wurde während der Dauer der geplanten Behandlung eingestellt.

localizedDescriptions.de: Der Rezeptentwurf wurde erstellt und wartet auf die Bestätigung durch einen autorisierten Arzt. Kann auch verwendet werden, wenn die Re-autorisierung gebündelt erfolgt. Dieser "careflow_step" hat den Status "geplant" oder "aktiv", was die Notwendigkeit widerspiegelt, sowohl Neuaufträge als auch erneut autorisierte Aufträge zu bearbeiten.
localizedDescriptions.ru: *Draft prescription has been prepared and is awaiting confirmation from an authorised clinician. May be used where reauthorisations are performed as a batch. This careflow_step may have a status of 'planned' or 'active', reflecting the need to to handle new orders as well as re-authorised orders.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Förslag på ordination har utarbetats och inväntar bekräftelse från en auktoriserad läkare. Kan användas där återauktorisering utförs som en batch. Detta flödessteg kan ha statusen "planerad" eller "aktiv", vilket återspeglar behovet av att hantera nya beställningar såväl som återauktoriserade ordrar.
localizedDescriptions.es-ar: *Draft prescription has been prepared and is awaiting confirmation from an authorised clinician. May be used where reauthorisations are performed as a batch. This careflow_step may have a status of 'planned' or 'active', reflecting the need to to handle new orders as well as re-authorised orders.(en)
localizedDescriptions.nb: Det er forberedt et utkast for en resept, og denne avventer godkjenning av en autorisert kliniker. Kan brukes der reseptutstedelse utføres satsvis. Dette prosesstrinnet kan brukes enten med status "planned" eller "active", for å underbygge behovet for å håndtere både nye og reautoriserte ordinasjoner.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: Rascunho da prescrição foi preparado e está aguardando confirmação de um clínico autorizado. Pode ser usado quando reautorizações são realizadas em lote. Esta etapa do processo de cuidado pode ter um estado de "planejado" ou "ativo", refletindo a necessidade de gerir novas solicitações assim como solicitações reautorizadas.
localizedDescriptions.en: Draft prescription has been prepared and is awaiting confirmation from an authorised clinician. May be used where reauthorisations are performed as a batch. localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 已经准备/书写好了处方草稿，正在等待授权临床医务人员的确认。可以用于批量执行重新授权的情况。照护服务流程步骤（careflow_step）的状态可能是“已计划”或“有效”，反映的则是需要处理新的医嘱以及重新授权的医嘱。
localizedDescriptions.ca: S’ha preparat un esborrany de la prescripció i està pendent de confirmació per part d’un metge autoritzat. Es pot utilitzar quan les reautoritzacions es fan per lots. Aquest careflow_step pot tenir un estat «planificat» o «actiu», cosa que reflecteix la necessitat de gestionar tant prescripcions noves com prescripcions reautoritzades.
localizedDescriptions.es: Se ha preparado una receta provisional y está pendiente de confirmación por parte de un clínico autorizado. Puede ser utilizada cuando se realicen reautorizaciones de forma conjunta. Este careflow_step puede tener un estado de "planificado" o "activo", reflejando la necesidad de manejar tanto órdenes nuevas como órdenes reautorizadas.

localizedDescriptions.de: Das Arzneimittel wurde zum ersten Mal von dem Patienten eingenommen oder ihm verabreicht. Obwohl in einigen Situationen das relevante Datum als erste von mehreren Anwendungen errechenbar ist, kann es in der Grundversorgung sein, dass genaue Verabreichungszeit nicht ohne weiteres verfügbar ist.
localizedDescriptions.ru: *The medication has been taken by, or administered to, the patient for the first time. Although in some settings this significant date may be computable as the first of several administrations, in other settings, such as primary care, specific administration dates are not readily available.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Läkemedlet har tagits av eller administrerats till patienten för första gången. I vissa fall kan startdatum för varje administrationstillfälle finnas tillgängligt, medan det i andra fall (såsom i primärvården) inte gör det.
localizedDescriptions.es-ar: *The medication has been taken by, or administered to, the patient for the first time. Although in some settings this significant date may be computable as the first of several administrations, in other settings, such as primary care, specific administration dates are not readily available.(en)
localizedDescriptions.nb: Legemiddelet er inntatt av eller administrert til pasienten for første gang. Selv om dette i noen bruksområder som f.eks. sykehus kan utledes fra den første av en rekke administreringer, må det i andre bruksområder som f.eks. allmennpraksis spesifiseres spesifikt siden administreringer ikke dokumenteres på samme måte.
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: A medicação foi adquirida, ou administrada, ao paciente pela primeira vez. Embora em algumas situações esta data significativa pode ser computada como a primeira de muitas administrações, em outras, como na atenção primária, datas de administração específicas não estão prontamente disponíveis.
localizedDescriptions.en: The medication has been taken by, or administered to, the patient for the first time. Although in some settings this significant date may be computable as the first of several administrations, in other settings, such as primary care, specific administration dates are not readily available.
localizedDescriptions.ar-sy: *The medication has been taken by, or administered to, the patient for the first time. Although in some settings this significant date may be computable as the first of several administrations, in other settings, such as primary care, specific administration dates are not readily available.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sl: *The medication has been taken by, or administered to, the patient for the first time. Although in some settings this significant date may be computable as the first of several administrations, in other settings, such as primary care, specific administration dates are not readily available.(en)
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 患者已经首次服用相应的药物，或者说已经对其进行了首次的施用/给药。 尽管在某些场所环境下，这一重要的日期可以作为多次施用/给药之中的第一次而用于计算，而在其他的场所环境下，如初级照护服务（基层医疗服务），具体的施用/给药日期并不容易获得。
localizedDescriptions.ca: El pacient ha pres o se li ha administrat la medicació per primera vegada. Encara que en alguns entorns es pugui computar aquesta data significativa com la primera de diverses administracions, en altres entorns, com atenció primària, les dates d’administració específiques no són fàcilment accessibles.
localizedDescriptions.es: El paciente ha tomado o se le ha administrado el medicamento por primera vez. Aunque en algunos entornos esta fecha significativa puede ser calculada como la primera de varias administraciones, en otros contextos, como la atención primaria, las fechas específicas de administración no están fácilmente disponibles.

localizedDescriptions.de: Eine Gabe des Arzneimittels wurde zurückgehalten und nicht gegeben. Es besteht keine Erwartung, dass sie später verabreicht wird, obwohl die nächste Dosis (falls es eine gibt) gemäß der ursprünglichen Verordnung verabreicht werden sollte.

localizedDescriptions.de: Die Verabreichung des Arzneimittels wurde bis zum Erhalt weiterer Informationen ausgesetzt. Es sollten keine weiteren Dosen, bis zur Bekanntgabe des neuen Startdatums oder bis die Bedingungen erfüllt sind, verabreicht werden. Wenn Sie das Datum/ die Voraussetzungen für den Neustart nach dem Aussetzen festlegen, sollte ein Schritt von "Verabreichung wurde ausgesetzt" und zurück zu "Arzneimittel Startdatum/Voraussetzung" ausgeführt werden.
localizedDescriptions.ru: *The administration of the medication has been suspended until further notice. No further doses should be given until the restart date or conditions have been met. When setting the date/conditions for restart after suspending, a step from ‘Administrations suspended’ and back to 'Medication start date/condition set' should be performed.(en)
localizedDescriptions.sv: Administreringen av läkemedlet har avbrutits tills vidare. Inga ytterligare doser ska ges förrän ett nytt startdatum har angivits eller villkoren har uppfyllts. Vid inställning av in datum/villkor för omstart, ska stegen från "Läkemedlets startdatum/fastställda villkor" till "Indragen administrering" utföras på nytt.
localizedDescriptions.es-ar: *The administration of the medication has been suspended until further notice. No further doses should be given until the restart date or conditions have been met. When setting the date/conditions for restart after suspending, a step from ‘Administrations suspended’ and back to 'Medication start date/condition set' should be performed.(en)
localizedDescriptions.nb: Administrering av legemiddelet er satt på vent inntil videre, ordinasjonen er "nullet". Ingen ytterligere doser gis før kriterium eller dato for å sette medisineringen i gang igjen er møtt. Når dato eller kriterium for å ny oppstart settes, bør det gjøres et 'suspend_step' tilbake til "Oppstartsdato satt".
localizedDescriptions.pt-br: A administração do medicamento foi suspensa até nova ordem. Doses adicionais não devem ser administradas até que a data de reinício ou condições forem alcançadas. Na configuração de nova data/condições para reinício após a suspensão, deve-se realizar a etapa de suspensão de Administrações suspensas e voltar a Data do início/ Condição de início.
localizedDescriptions.en: The administration of the medication has been suspended until further notice. No further doses should be given until the restart date or conditions have been met. When setting the date/conditions for restart after suspending, a step from ‘Administrations suspended’ and back to 'Medication start date/condition set' should be performed.

When setting the date/conditions for restart after suspending, a step from ‘Administrations suspended’ and back to 'Medication start date/condition set' should be performed.(en)
localizedDescriptions.zh-cn: 已经暂停了相应药物的施用/给药，直至另行通知。 在重新开始日期之前或满足种种条件之前，不应再进行给予更多的剂量药物。 在设置暂停之后的重新开始日期/条件时，应当执行从“已暂停的施用/给药”（Administrations suspended）返回到“已设定的用药开始日期/条件”（Medication start date/condition set）的步骤。
localizedDescriptions.ca: S’ha suspès l’administració de la medicació fins a nou avís. No s’han d’administrar més dosis fins que no es compleixin la data o les condicions de reinici. Quan s’estableixin les condicions/data de reinici després de la suspensió, cal realitzar una fase des d'«Administració suspesa» i tornar a «Data d’inici de la medicació/condicions establertes».
localizedDescriptions.es: La administración del medicamento ha sido suspendida hasta nuevo aviso.
